import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {

    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"sysml\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("package P {}\n", config)
    println(result)
